description: This file defines a class Compressed that extends the Formatter class within the SCSSPHP library. It implements a compressed formatter for SCSS output, focusing on minified CSS generation by removing unnecessary whitespace and comments.

classes.name: Compressed
classes.description: A class that formats SCSS code into a compressed, minified style.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Compressed formatter with settings optimized for compression.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs lines of a CSS block, removing comments and joining lines without extra whitespace.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors for a CSS block in a compressed format, removing spaces around combinators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Sets default properties for compressed output format.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Formats a block of CSS lines for minified output, removing comments and extra whitespace.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs selectors in a compressed form, suitable for minified CSS.
